summary_1line: Bhishma begins a tale of Vyasa and a frightened worm to explain attachment to life and karmic rebirth shaped by past cruelty.

image_candidates.scene_text: On a dusty road, the sage Vyasa bends toward a terrified worm racing away as a rumbling bullock cart thunders closer.
The tiny worm looks up at the towering sage while the shadow of a heavy cart and straining bulls looms over the road.
The worm recounts its past life as a cruel wealthy man, the memory contrasting a rich human figure with the small crawling creature.
